$comment: The surfaces the tap-target audit covers, and the ones it knowingly does not.
Committed so that 'which sixteen screens' is a file rather than folklore.
session:  none      — signed out. /sign-in and /sign-up only exist this way.
onboarded — a fixture account that has finished onboarding.
new       — a fixture account that has not; /onboarding redirects
{universityId} and {testId} are filled in by scripts/mint-audit-session.ts
from whatever is actually on the dev branch. Hard-coding ids here would rot
the first time the branch is reset from its parent.
Anything in `deferred` is UNMEASURED, not passing. Each carries the reason,
so a gap reads as a gap instead of an omission.

deferred.reason: the essays table is empty on the dev branch; needs essay content
the fixture account has no completed test results
the fixture account has no in-progress practice session
only reachable part-way through a full modular test run

nonProduct.reason: a review surface, not product. Guarded to development only in app/design-system/layout.tsx, and its findings never count toward a product number.
